notes.title: Update 2.2 Trading Cards
notes.notes:
-Steam Trading Cards are now available.
-Over world map.
-Difficulty increased as well as stats of items.
-Updated and added more music.
-Fiend, Wolves, Rats Achievement fixed.
-Gollum ice maze monster has a new loot table.
-Small gameplay tweaks and sprite changes.

notes.title: Update 1.92
notes.notes:
-Music no longer fades when enemies are on screen.
-You now start the game with 13 coins.
-Ghost girl Achievement fix.
-Fixed the screen glitches when scaled to abnormal sizes.
-Enemy damage slightly increased.
-New Game+ enemy HP and damage increased.
-Normal item drop rate decreased.
-Potion drop rate decreased.
